_comment: THE ONE WINDOW A FINISHED WORKSPACE'S PAGE IS HELD FOR (owner ruling,
2026-10-30). A workspace whose last turn ended less than hold_seconds ago
keeps its page loaded (lisp/page-unload.el), and the sidebar fades its
name from its status tone to its resting grey over the same hold_seconds
(webapp/src/sidebar/name-tint.ts). So the fade is the indicator of how
close the page is to being unloaded: a name fully faded is a page that
may be unloaded. Both runtimes read this file; neither spells the value.
